### 1. Scene
A mixed buffet-style meal: leafy salad with beans, roasted vegetables, a tomato-topped pizza or flatbread slice, and rice with meat and vegetables.

### 2. Vessel
A rounded rectangular dinner plate, approximately **27 × 25 cm**. Using an equivalent circular diameter of **26 cm**, its area is approximately **530 cm²**.

### 3. Items
Visible foods appear to include:
- Leafy greens
- Beans with shredded carrot and other small salad vegetables
- Roasted potato and squash pieces
- Tomato-topped pizza or flatbread
- White rice
- Browned meat pieces
- Cooked zucchini and other vegetables
- A light oil coating, particularly on the roasted foods

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight and energy
Areas below partition the food-covered plate; overlapping toppings are assigned to their respective components.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 20% | 106 × 2.7 = 286 ml | 0.15 → 43 g | 25 | 11 |
| Beans and shredded salad vegetables | 7% | 37 × 1.1 = 41 ml | 0.65 → 27 g | 100 | 27 |
| Roasted potato and squash | 22% | 117 × 2.0 = 234 ml | 0.65 → 152 g | 115 | 175 |
| Tomato pizza/flatbread | 19% | 101 × 1.0 = 101 ml | 0.95 → 96 g | 250 | 240 |
| Cooked white rice | 9% | 48 × 1.0 = 48 ml | 0.8 → 38 g | 130 | 49 |
| Browned meat | 8% | 42 × 1.2 = 50 ml | 0.95 → 48 g | 220 | 106 |
| Cooked zucchini and mixed vegetables | 7% | 37 × 1.6 = 59 ml | 0.6 → 36 g | 40 | 14 |
| Visible oil coating | Overlapping | Thin coating, approximately 7 ml | 0.9 → 6 g | 884 | 53 |

**Coverage check:** 92% of the plate. Oil overlaps the other foods rather than adding coverage. The food energy densities exclude this separately counted oil.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **546 g and approximately 775 kcal**, plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate. Rice is only a small component; roasted vegetables and flatbread account for much of the visible bulk. Uncertainty is roughly ±25%, chiefly from food identification, pile depth and oil.
